revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - This is fine. Note that the ed.pr. and SB 12 placed an overstroke above the numeral κ in l. 12. The DDbDP text omits it, presumably because the stroke, which is visible on the image, is understood to be the abbreviation mark above Φαμεν. Also, re: λε̣υ̣κ̣[ὴ]ν at the end of line 4, traces in both the printed photo and online image suggest a rounded letter between kappa and nu; they don't really fit eta. λευκὸν is not impossible, and the mistake is attested elsewhere (P.Grenf. 2 46.13), but without being able to examine the original, I would hesitate mentioning it in the app. or comm.

Submit - BL and small PN corrections to lin4; my point was to verify the one recorded in BL XI 212, which was not an improvement. The text is essentially as emended in BL VIII 366, with a few dots and brackets added. Apart from the published photo, there is a scan at http://ccat.sas.upenn.edu/rak//ppenn/museum/greek/16697-12.jpg/. The suggestion for lin8 in BL VIII 366 is difficult.
